description: 2016 Mustang Shelby GT 350 for sale! Motorcar Classics is proud to present this breathtaking, investment-grade 2016 Ford Mustang Shelby GT350 with an astonishingly low 1,677 original miles. This pristine example is finished in iconic Oxford White paired with classic blue racing stripes, a timeless combination that pays direct homage to Carroll Shelby's original 1965 masterpiece. Step inside the cockpit to find a driver-focused cabin featuring Ebony leather and sueded seats that look, feel, and smell exactly as they did when this vehicle rolled off the assembly line. Mated exclusively to a crisp 6-speed manual transmission, this Shelby delivers a raw, engaging driving experience that connects the driver directly to the tarmac.Beyond its striking looks and flawless condition, this particular GT350 comes highly optioned with the desirable Technology Package, seamlessly blending high-performance heritage with modern convenience. The package elevates the cabin with an upgraded infotainment system, premium audio, dual-zone automatic climate control, and voice-activated navigation, making it as comfortable on a weekend cruise as it is potent on the track. Under the hood lies the legendary 5.2-liter "Voodoo" V8 engine, a high-revving masterpiece with a flat-plane crankshaft that produces an unmistakable, exotic exhaust note and 526 horsepower.For the discerning enthusiast, the collectability aspect of this vehicle cannot be overstated. As a low-mileage, exceptionally well-preserved model from the celebrated S550 generation, this Shelby GT350 represents a pinnacle era of naturally aspirated American muscle. With the automotive landscape rapidly shifting toward hybridization and electrification, pristine, low-mileage examples of the high-revving "Voodoo" V8 are rapidly climbing the ranks of highly sought-after modern classics. Whether you are looking to anchor a world-class collection or enjoy one of the finest driver's cars ever built by Ford, this Oxford White beauty is an unparalleled opportunity.Your inspection is invited!

The 2017 VW Jetta GLI in Platinum Grey Metallic is a sporty and stylish sedan that combines turbocharged performance, modern technology, and everyday practicality into one exciting package. Known as the performance version of the Jetta lineup, the GLI delivers a fun and responsive driving experience while still offering the comfort and efficiency needed for daily commuting and long road trips. The Platinum Grey Metallic exterior gives the Jetta GLI a sleek and sophisticated appearance, adding a clean metallic shine that perfectly matches the cars sporty design and European styling.

The exterior of the 2017 Jetta GLI features aggressive body lines, a sporty front grille with red accents, stylish alloy wheels, LED lighting, and a lower sport-tuned stance that gives the sedan a bold and athletic look. The Platinum Grey Metallic paint enhances the GLIs sharp design and gives the car a premium appearance that looks modern and refined. The metallic grey finish shines beautifully in different lighting conditions and gives the GLI a sporty yet elegant personality that stands out without being overly flashy.

Inside, the 2017 VW Jetta GLI offers a comfortable and driver-focused interior designed with sporty touches and modern convenience in mind. The cabin features supportive sport seats, quality materials, a leather-wrapped steering wheel, red stitching accents, and a clean dashboard layout that creates a refined and sporty atmosphere. The seats are comfortable for both short commutes and long drives, while the spacious cabin provides generous headroom and legroom for front and rear passengers. The trunk also offers plenty of cargo space for luggage, groceries, backpacks, or travel gear, making the GLI practical as well as fun to drive.

Under the hood, the 2017 Jetta GLI is powered by a turbocharged engine that delivers strong horsepower and quick acceleration. Paired with either a smooth manual transmission or an automatic transmission, the GLI provides responsive handling, sporty performance, and an exciting driving experience. The sport-tuned suspension and upgraded brakes help the car feel agile and controlled around corners while still maintaining a comfortable ride for everyday use. Drivers appreciate the GLI for offering sporty performance while remaining practical and comfortable enough for daily driving.

Technology is another strong feature of the 2017 VW Jetta GLI. The sedan comes equipped with a touchscreen infotainment system, Bluetooth connectivity, navigation capability, USB ports, premium audio, smartphone integration, and convenient steering wheel controls that help drivers stay connected and entertained while on the road. Features such as push-button start, keyless entry, dual-zone climate control, blind-spot monitoring, rear traffic alert, and a rearview camera add extra convenience and confidence during every drive.

The Platinum Grey Metallic exterior color gives this Jetta GLI a particularly refined and sporty personality. The metallic grey finish pairs perfectly with the GLIs sporty styling details and gives the car a clean and sophisticated look that remains timeless. The color highlights the sharp body lines and gives the sedan a modern European appearance that looks both sporty and classy.

Overall, the 2017 VW Jetta GLI in Platinum Grey Metallic is an excellent sport sedan for drivers who want performance, comfort, technology, and style all in one vehicle. Its turbocharged engine, sporty handling, spacious interior, and elegant metallic grey exterior make it a great choice for commuters, car enthusiasts, and anyone looking for a fun and practical sedan with sporty character and everyday reliability.

The 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ stands out as a heavy-duty pickup designed for serious work and comfort, featuring a one-owner history and a robust set of luxury and utility features.

This truck is ideal for buyers researching a reliable and powerful pickup for both demanding workloads and comfortable daily driving. The locally owned, one-owner background adds confidence for those prioritizing vehicle history. Its combination of heated and cooled leather seating, dual-zone climate control, and advanced driver assistance features appeals to professionals needing a capable vehicle for hauling, as well as families requiring comfort on longer trips. In regions with variable weather like Eastern Iowa, standard 4WD and features such as heated second-row seats and a heated steering wheel offer practicality during harsh winters. The Silverado 2500HD LTZ is particularly appealing for buyers who want a truck that balances rugged strength with high-end amenities.

Under the hood, the Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel delivers substantial torque and smooth power delivery, supported by a responsive 10-speed automatic transmission. The 4WD system ensures that traction is reliable on various surfaces, whether towing equipment or navigating muddy job sites. Real-world driving impressions reflect a composed ride for a heavy-duty truck, thanks to an advanced suspension package and independent front suspension. The exhaust brake and engine block heater enhance cold-weather and towing performance, making the Silverado 2500HD LTZ a confident choice for both work and travel. Smooth shifting and a well-tuned chassis contribute to low-stress commuting and controlled handling, even when the truck is loaded or pulling a trailer.

Safety is a focal point in this truck, with features designed to mitigate risks and enhance driver confidence. Lane Departure Warning and Lane Keep Assist help the driver maintain proper lane position on highways, while Blind Spot Monitoring and Rear Cross Traffic Alert provide critical awareness when changing lanes or reversing. The 360-degree camera system and Hitch Guidance with Hitch View simplify maneuvering and trailer connections, reducing the chance of accidents in tight spaces. Ultrasonic Front and Rear Park Assist further assists with low-speed parking, and Electronic Stability Control and ABS work to maintain control during sudden maneuvers or adverse road conditions. The combination of these active safety systems allows drivers to focus on the task at hand, knowing the truck is equipped to help prevent common hazards.

This Silverado 2500HD LTZ is loaded with both functional and luxury features, elevating daily use. The LTZ Convenience Package, LTZ Convenience Package II, and LTZ Plus Package bundle amenities such as memory seating, power-adjustable driver and passenger seats, and a premium Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system with navigation and SiriusXM with 360L.

When compared to competitors like the Ford F-250 Super Duty and Ram 2500, the Silverado 2500HD LTZ distinguishes itself with a blend of advanced driver assistance features and luxury appointments in the LTZ trim.

What are the key features of this truck? It includes a Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel, 10-speed automatic, 4WD, Jet Black leather seats, navigation, heated and cooled seating, 360-degree camera, and multiple convenience packages. How does it perform in daily driving? The truck delivers smooth acceleration, stable ride quality, and responsive transmission behavior, even when loaded or towing. What safety systems are included?
